title: Edit from an archived tier opens the archived grid view
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new archived tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, archived first.
  • Have a new archived tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, archived after tier A.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, tier A 45% markup, tier B on Same as previous tier, Default 40% margin.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click tier A's row on the Tiers list.
  3. Click Edit on matrix A's row.
  4. Point at a cell in tier B's column.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Tier A shows among the archived rows.

Step 2:

  • Tier A's page opens with Archived beside its name.

Step 3:

  • The grid shows Default, then tier A, then tier B (archived first, earliest first).
  • No active tier column shows.
  • A notice at the top reads "Archived tiers don't price parts. Reactivate a tier and assign customers to use these rules."
  • The Price Part Simulator under it shows Default, tier A and tier B.

Step 4:

  • Tier B's cells read Uses previous tier and follow tier A, the column to its left.
